items.title: India's CERT-In issues AI Security Auditing guidelines targeting model poisoning, prompt injection, agentic AI threats
items.summary: India's national CERT published AI security auditing guidelines covering prompt injection, data and model poisoning, and excessive agency in agentic systems.

items.title: PlayStation 4 System Software Update 14.02: November 2026 Patch Notes
items.summary: Sony shipped PS4 firmware 14.02 on November 4 with security fixes and no new features. It arrived shortly after a public 14.00 jailbreak, but Sony has not said whether it targets that exploit.

items.title: Promising PS5 console jailbreak won't work on recent firmware as Sony combats exploits
items.summary: Reports that the 'Prolapse' method aimed at PS5 firmware 14.00/14.10 is blocked by 14.20. The 14.22 update released November 2 added more security fixes.

items.title: exclusive: AI security company Gray Swan relaunches Red Team Arena contest to jailbreak AI agents
items.summary: Gray Swan is overhauling its public red-teaming platform for AI agents, adding sandboxed environments where participants can try to jailbreak agents safely.

items.title: New AI jailbreak: get your chatbot drunk
items.summary: Covers a UNSW paper reporting that telling chatbots to role-play as intoxicated weakened their guardrails on JailbreakBench and a private-data-leak benchmark.

items.title: PS4 Update 14.00 Released on September 16 Brings More of What You Expect
items.summary: Sony released PS4 system software 14.00, a security-focused update. Research notes say it patched the kernel bug used by earlier 13.xx exploits.

items.title: iOS 26 Gets First Jailbreak Thanks to Dopamine
items.summary: Dopamine 3.0 is the first public iOS 26 jailbreak, arriving 326 days after iOS 26 launched. It supports only iOS 26.0–26.0.1 on A12 and A13 devices.

items.title: New PS4 CSSFontFace exploit turns a font bug into a big deal
items.summary: Describes a WebKit CSSFontFace bug in the PS4 browser, with attention centred on firmware 9.00. The article says it is not a shortcut to a full jailbreak on current firmware.

items.title: The "unhackable" Xbox One has been hacked — and Microsoft can't patch it
items.summary: Covers the 'Bliss' voltage double-glitch attack presented at RE//verse 2026, which bypasses the original Xbox One boot ROM. It needs physical access and is described as unpatchable in software.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak For Firmware 14.00 Has Been Released, Allowing Users To Cheat In GTA Online
items.summary: Reports that a browser-based jailbreak for PS4 firmware 14.00 has gone public, and notes concerns about it being used for online cheating.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak on Firmware 14.00 Available
items.summary: News post on a public WebKit-based exploit chain for PS4 firmware 14.00. Coverage says it loads a GoldHEN 2.4b18.x build that adds 14.00 support.

items.title: Reports of PlayStation 4 hack on firmware 14.00 have appeared
items.summary: Early report of a PS4 being compromised on firmware 14.00. It advised readers to stay skeptical about an imminent user-friendly release.

items.title: Sony Releases PS4 Firmware Update 14.02 With Security Fixes Following Recent Jailbreak
items.summary: Links Sony's PS4 14.02 security update to the recent 14.00 jailbreak, though Sony has not confirmed that the update closes those specific exploits.

items.title: New PS5 jailbreak works on almost every firmware version
items.summary: Covers the public 'Relapse' jailbreak released September 29, which chains a WebKit flaw with a kernel race condition. It covers PS5 firmware 7.00–13.60, including PS5 Pro.

items.title: New PS5 firmware update blocks Relapse jailbreak ahead of GTA 6 release
items.summary: Reports that Sony's 14.x PS5 firmware updates block the Relapse exploit chain, and frames the timing around the upcoming GTA 6 launch.

items.title: Nintendo Pulls SmileBASIC 4 as Tethered Switch 2 Jailbreak ns2jb Appears
items.summary: Researcher pepsipu released ns2jb, a tethered, non-persistent Switch 2 jailbreak that uses SmileBASIC 4 on firmware 23.0.1. Nintendo then removed the app from some eShop storefronts.

items.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Gets a New Offline Userland Exploit That Works Across All Firmware Versions
items.summary: Developer Gezine unveiled an offline userland exploit for Switch and Switch 2 that doesn't rely on WebKit. No kernel-level exploit has been confirmed.

items.title: Xbox hacked 2026: what is true
items.summary: Fact-check stating that no public jailbreak exists for Xbox Series X|S and no Xbox server breach is confirmed. It attributes the confusion to the Xbox One Bliss hack and the 2024 Collateral Damage exploit.

items.title: Magisk v30 vs KernelSU v3: Which Root Solution in 2026?
items.summary: Compares the current Android root options, Magisk v30 and KernelSU v3, including KernelSU's new metamodule system and how each handles Play Integrity checks.

items.title: Researchers Uncover Prompt Adware Hidden in OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit
items.summary: Check Point found that 'Haiou', a free Codex jailbreak bundle, edits agent instruction files so later responses advertise a paid third-party AI gateway. Code-focused scanners can miss this kind of plain-text persistence.

items.title: Prompt Adware: Jailbreak Bundles, Instruction-File Persistence, and Gray-Market Gateways
items.summary: CSA research note on the prompt-adware pattern, where jailbreak bundles persist through coding-agent instruction files and steer users to gray-market API gateways.

items.title: Brazilian lawyers busted for attempting to manipulate court's AI with prompt injection hidden in filing
items.summary: A Brazilian labor court's AI flagged hidden white-on-white text in a filing that tried to steer its review. The lawyers were fined about $16,000.

items.title: OpenAI raises Bio Bounty reward to $50,000 for frontier model jailbreaks
items.summary: Reports that OpenAI expanded its private bio-safety bug bounty to cover GPT-5.6 and GPT-5.5, raising the top reward for a universal jailbreak to $50,000.

items.title: Hackers Turn to AI Jailbreak Bundles as Researchers Uncover New Prompt Adware Technique
items.summary: Further coverage of the Haiou jailbreak bundle, which combines role-play and CTF-framing prompt techniques with ad-injecting instructions.

items.title: Red-team study of frontier Anthropic models (arXiv 2606.18193)
items.summary: June 2026 paper that ran hundreds of thousands of adaptive and static attack attempts against Anthropic models. It concludes that adaptive attacks still expose significant residual jailbreak vulnerabilities.

items.title: SoK: Jailbreak attacks, defenses and evaluation (arXiv 2605.05058)
items.summary: May 2026 systematization paper that benchmarks 13 jailbreak attacks against 5 defenses. It finds that attack-success-rate alone often contradicts multi-dimensional evaluations.

items.title: Next-generation Constitutional Classifiers
items.summary: Anthropic research update on its classifier-based jailbreak defenses. The first generation cut jailbreak success from 86% to 4.4% in testing.

items.title: AI jailbreaking via poetry: bypassing chatbot defenses with rhyme
items.summary: Explains a study of 25 models that found rewriting harmful requests as verse raised unsafe-response rates. Hand-picked prompts produced the highest reported bypass figures.

items.title: Jailbreak News: 14.22 Released, GoldHEN on 14.00, CivSwitch, BD-JB Relapse, FPKG Update & More!
items.summary: News roundup covering PS5 firmware 14.22, GoldHEN support on PS4 14.00, BD-JB Relapse and other scene updates.

items.title: New PS4 14.00 Jailbreak Release: What You Need to Know
items.summary: Overview of the newly public PS4 firmware 14.00 jailbreak and what it means for users.

items.title: The Current State Of The PS4 14.00 Jailbreak.
items.summary: Status update on jailbreak progress for PS4 firmware 14.00.

items.title: The PS4 Jailbreak Situation in 2026: Everything You Need to Know
items.summary: Explainer on which PS4 firmware versions can be jailbroken in 2026. It says support reaches 14.00 and that 14.02 has only a private demo.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News Update: BD-J Sandbox Escape Confirmed on 13.50 and below
items.summary: Reports a confirmed BD-J (Blu-ray Java) sandbox escape affecting PS4 firmware 13.50 and earlier.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: New WebKit and Blu-Ray Userland exploits revealed up to the latest firmwares
items.summary: Covers newly disclosed WebKit and Blu-ray userland bugs affecting PS4 up to 13.52 and PS5 up to 13.60.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: 13.50 PS4 & 13.00 PS5 Firmware Released, PSVue Patched, Luac0re 2.1 & More!
items.summary: News roundup on PS4 firmware 13.50 patching the Vue-after-Free exploit, the PS5 13.00 release, and a Luac0re 2.1 update.

items.title: PS5 7.00 - 13.60 Relapse Jailbreak Released! (No PC + WebKit Autoloader)
items.summary: Announces the Relapse PS5 jailbreak covering firmware 7.00–13.60 and a WebKit autoloader that runs without a PC.

items.title: Dopamine 3.0 IS OUT! | iOS 26.0.1 & Older Jailbreak | Installation Guide + Important Notes
items.summary: Covers the Dopamine 3.0 release, which adds jailbreak support up to iOS 26.0.1, with notes on its device and version limits.
